name: Boiled Rice Pudding No. 1
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cold boiled rice
ingredients.originalText: one cupful of cold boiled rice

ingredients.name: drops of essence of lemon
ingredients.originalText: ten drops of essence of lemon

instructions.text: Put rice, sugar, eggs, soda and salt in a bowl and beat it up until it is very light and white
Beat four ounces of butter to a cream and put it into the pudding with ten drops of essence of lemon
Butter a mold and pour the pudding into it

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put rice, sugar, eggs, soda and salt in a bowl and beat it up until it is very light and white
2. Beat four ounces of butter to a cream and put it into the pudding with ten drops of essence of lemon
3. Beat altogether for five minutes
4. Butter a mold and pour the pudding into it
5. Boil for two hours
6. Serve with sweet fruit sauce
